Listing credit 5-pack

£40.00 ex VAT

Available

Terms & Conditions for this item, including the no-cash-refund and 12-month expiry rules, are shown here before purchase and agreed again at checkout.

Five listing credits for the price of four. Each credit publishes one community event on West Coast Today’s What’s On once an editor has approved it.

Submit your events from My account whenever you like. A credit is held when you submit and only deducted when the listing is approved; if we cannot publish it, the credit goes back to your balance.

  1. One credit publishes one event listing once approved.
  2. A credit is held when you submit and only deducted on approval; a declined listing returns its credit.
  3. Credits have no cash value and are not refundable, except where a listing fails because of a platform fault.
  4. Credits expire 12 months after purchase. A 5-pack is not transferable.

What’s On listing terms

  1. One credit publishes one event listing once approved.
  2. A credit is held when you submit and only deducted on approval; a declined listing returns its credit.
